answer.reason: The verses tell of Daniel interpreting a king's dream, reading the writing for Belshazzar and being delivered from the lions' den, none of which the summary states.

clauses.english: revealed and interpreted Nebuchadnezzar's dream when the wise men could not
clauses.quote: seeing thou couldest reveal this secret

clauses.english: read and interpreted the writing that appeared before Belshazzar
clauses.quote: yet I will read the writing unto the king, and make known to him the interpretation

clauses.english: was cast into the den of lions and taken out unhurt
clauses.quote: no manner of hurt was found upon him

doubts: EZK 14:14, EZK 14:20 and EZK 28:3 name a Daniel, but mention no deed of his, so they are not cited.
Dream and vision passages (DAN 7-12) were left out as visions received, not chief deeds.
